description: Defines the WebSocketHttp2HandshakeStream class for handling WebSocket handshake over HTTP/2 in the Chromium project, including method declarations, member variables, and class inheritance.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp2HandshakeStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket handshake over HTTP/2, manages stream initialization, request sending, response handling, and stream upgrade.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info with the stream.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP/2 stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends the HTTP request headers and initiates the handshake.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers from the server.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally marking it as not reusable.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection has been reused.

methods.name: SetConnectionReused
methods.description: Marks the connection as reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Determines if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Retrieves alternative service info.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Gets load timing information.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL connection info.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Gets SSL certificate request info.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the remote endpoint address.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Drains the session with the given network session.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Renews the stream for authentication purposes.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases for the remote endpoint.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns the Accept-CH via ALPS.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the handshake stream to a WebSocketStream after successful handshake.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Checks if data can be read from the stream.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the stream.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Callback when headers are sent.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Callback when headers are received.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Callback when the stream is closed.

methods.name: StartRequestCallback
methods.description: Callback when the request stream is ready.
